newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PRIME MINISTER TO VISIT DENMARK, BELGIUM.
newsitem.headline: PRIME MINISTER TO VISIT DENMARK, BELGIUM.

text.p: Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius will meet with Danish business groups and government officials during a visit this week to the Nordic country, the government's press office said on Monday.

The press office said in a statement that European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene and the president of the Lithuanian Confederation of Industrialists, Bronislovas Lubys, will accompany the prime minister.
The delegation will meet with Danish Prime Minister Paul Nyrup Rasmussen, the East Investment Fund and Denmark's confederation of industrialists, Danske Industri.
The delegation is in Denmark on Thursday and flies to Belgium on Friday for meetings with European Commission President Jacques Santer and senior Belgian government officials.
